ulasan.Ulasan: The pricing is not transparent. Promotions are advertised, but the actual prices do not match the promotional offers. They also do not provide a clear price list for their treatment packages.  Despite informing them about the promotion details and expected pricing, the sales/marketing team did not address the concern, which was very disappointing. Due to this poor service experience, I would not recommend this place.  That said, the salon itself is clean, and the staff performing the treatments are good. (Visited date 21st April -17.15hr)
